parsed.rationale: Both participating records live in test targets: one in 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' (package: Metadata) and the other in 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift' (package: app:iOS). Although the context flags do not set is_test=true, the file paths unambiguously place both declarations inside test bundles (the 'Tests/' directory segments and 'Tests' suffixes on the package names). The type 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver.MockError' is a nested mock error type used as a test fixture in two separate test suites that exercise different formatters/parsers; the duplication is intentional isolation between test modules. Consolidating these into shared production code would couple test-only error semantics into a non-test target, which is undesirable.
